$Comment: A boss's void bomb blast, shared by every boss in this pack that throws the void instead of fire: each player within 3 blocks takes Void damage (ziggfreed-common's Void cause) and a shove, in a burst of the game's own void impact. The one hit rule matches Player only, so the boss who threw it and his own creatures are never hurt by it; it is a creature's blast, so the world's PvP setting never filters it. IgnoreOwner skips the thrower whatever the rule says. It is Orbis_Boss_Bomb_Burst with the void in place of fire and no Burn; a bomb that also sets the ground alight names Orbis_Boss_Fire_Patch_Spawn beside it. Range is the radius in blocks; BaseDamage and Knockback.Force set how hard it hits.
